title: [GP-151]: Fix custom MyGame level launch crash from missing pig palette config
description: Opening the custom MyGame level crashes in the vehicle builder because PaletteSpriteRegistry cannot find `pig.width`. Add or handle palette sprite metadata for pig so user-created levels can launch instead of throwing MissingResourceException.

title: [GP-152]: Verify and fix placing selected objects in authoring
description: In authoring, selected objects may not actually be placeable onto the level. Confirm the current placement flow and fix it so choosing an object from the palette reliably lets the user place it in the level.

title: [GP-153]: Make selected object properties panel functional
description: The right-side panel for the selected object currently does nothing. When an object is selected, the panel should show relevant properties and allow supported edits or clearly communicate read-only state.

title: [GP-154]: Wire undo and redo buttons in authoring
description: The undo and redo buttons are no longer connected to the editing history. Reconnect them so authoring actions can be undone and redone from the UI.

title: [GP-155]: Fix terrain PNG rendering showing solid colors
description: Terrain PNG/image implementation does not work; terrain currently appears as a solid color instead of rendering the configured image. Investigate the terrain rendering path and make PNG-backed terrain display correctly.

title: [GP-156]: Prevent select mode from dragging terrain while mouse-dragging
description: In select mode, simply dragging the mouse around causes a block of terrain to follow the cursor. Select mode should not create or drag terrain unless the user is intentionally moving an already-selected terrain object.

title: [GP-157]: Display terrain properties in authoring UI
description: Show useful terrain properties such as terrain name and friction in the authoring interface so users can understand what terrain they are editing or placing.

title: [GP-158]: Add focused tests for authoring terrain and selection workflows
description: Add tests around the highest-risk authoring workflows, including terrain placement/rendering, selected-object behavior, undo/redo, and palette/level launch regressions.

title: [GP-159]: Add descriptive info for level items
description: Add info text for level items explaining what each one does so users understand the purpose and behavior of items available in the authoring palette.

title: [GP-160]: Remove persistent blue box from game player screen
description: A persistent blue box appears on the game player screen and cannot be removed. Investigate the player overlay/UI state and ensure the box can be dismissed or does not appear unintentionally.

title: [GP-161]: Load selected world when editing an existing world
description: The edit existing world button opens a blank screen instead of loading the selected world. Wire the selected world data into the editor so the existing world opens populated.

title: [GP-162]: Preserve terrain blocks when saving levels
description: Terrain blocks silently vanish on save. Ensure terrain entities are serialized and reloaded reliably, and surface save failures instead of losing data silently.

title: [GP-163]: Avoid crash when loading object-only levels without game.json
description: Loading a level that contains objects but no game.json crashes. Add graceful handling for missing game metadata so the level can load or report a clear recoverable error.

title: [GP-164]: Resolve game.json for levels saved in others directory
description: game.json lookup fails silently for levels saved in the others/ directory. Update lookup paths and error reporting so saved levels find their game metadata consistently.

title: [GP-165]: Clean up joints when components reach zero hp
description: Joints are not cleaned up when a component hits 0 hp. Remove or invalidate attached joints when components are destroyed so physics state does not retain broken connections.

title: [GP-166]: Apply saved gravity and drag in the engine
description: Gravity and drag are saved to JSON but the engine never uses them. Load those values into the runtime physics configuration so saved world settings affect gameplay.

title: [GP-167]: Show score live during gameplay
description: Score is only shown on the result screen. Add live score display during gameplay and keep it synchronized with score changes.

title: [GP-168]: Make win and loss conditions data-driven
description: Win/loss conditions are hardcoded to pigs, so a game without pigs can never be won. Move win/loss rules into configurable data so games can define their own objectives.

title: [GP-169]: Honor configurable camera behavior
description: The camera always follows the player even when cameraFollows is configured differently. Support fixed, side-scroll, and player-follow camera modes from saved configuration.

title: [GP-170]: Add auto-scroll and input-rule configuration
description: There is no auto-scroll or input-rule system, which prevents games like dinosaur runners or riders. Add configurable scrolling and input rules so game genres can define movement behavior without code changes.

title: [GP-171]: Replace hardcoded collision effect switch with registry
description: Collision effects are implemented as a hardcoded string switch. Introduce a pluggable registry or dispatcher so new effects can be added from data or extension points without editing core Java switch logic.

title: [GP-172]: Add data-driven component registry interface
description: There is no way to define new component types from data. Add a component registry interface that lets games register and instantiate component types through configuration.

title: [GP-173]: Add extensible ability registry
description: Input-to-action mapping is not extensible. Add an ability registry so games can define abilities and map controls to actions without hardcoding behavior.

title: [GP-174]: Migrate existing components to component registry
description: Once the component registry exists, migrate existing component types to use it so old and new components share the same creation path.

title: [GP-175]: Make collision dispatcher pluggable
description: The collision dispatcher is hardcoded at construction. Allow dispatch behavior to be registered or injected so games can customize collision handling.

title: [GP-176]: Consume registered abilities in the game engine
description: The game engine does not consume registered abilities. Wire ability definitions into runtime input handling so registered actions actually execute during gameplay.

title: [GP-177]: Make level progression data-driven
description: Level progression is hardcoded to five level names. Load progression from game or world configuration so games can define arbitrary level sequences.

title: [GP-178]: Improve actor editor panel
description: Improve the actor editor panel so sprite, physics, abilities, and controls can be configured clearly from authoring.

title: [GP-179]: Add rules editor panel
description: Add an authoring rules editor panel for configuring game objectives, scoring, win/loss conditions, and related rules.

title: [GP-180]: Add camera and controls config panel
description: Add an authoring panel for configuring camera behavior and controls, including camera follow mode and input mappings.

title: [GP-181]: Generalize terrain properties panel into reusable entity editor
description: The terrain properties panel should become a reusable entity editor that can support terrain, pickups, actors, and other entity types.

title: [GP-182]: Extend selected object properties to pickups and actors
description: The selected object properties panel only works for terrain. Extend it so selected pickups and actors expose relevant editable properties too.

title: [GP-183]: Add tooltips and descriptions to palette items
description: Palette items do not have tooltips or descriptions. Add concise descriptions so authors understand what each item does before placing it.
